map.用于急性冠脉综合征（ACS）患者院内死亡风险预测。依据 GRACE 注册研究，综: Predicts in-hospital mortality risk for acute coronary syndrome (ACS) patients. Based on the GRACE registry, integrating 8 indicators by table lookup with summation; higher score means higher risk.
map.📖 查看「GRACE 缺血事件风险评分 使用指南」: View the GRACE Ischemic Event Risk Score User Guide
map.本工具依据 GRACE 注册研究评分累加评估急性冠脉综合征缺血与死亡风险；评分在: This tool assesses ACS ischemic and mortality risk by GRACE registry score summation; scoring runs locally, data is not uploaded, results are for reference only, and invasive timing follows the guidelines.
map.GRACE 评分用于 ACS（不稳定心绞痛/非ST段抬高/ST段抬高心梗）患者的: GRACE score is used for prognostic risk stratification in ACS (unstable angina / NSTEMI / STEMI) patients
map.低危≤108 分，中危 109-140 分，高危>140 分；高危患者建议尽早血: Low risk <=108, intermediate 109-140, high >140; high-risk patients are advised early revascularization
map.血肌酐 1 mg/dL ≈ 88.4 μmol/L，输入时请注意单位换算: Serum creatinine 1 mg/dL ~ 88.4 micromol/L; please note unit conversion when entering
map.本工具仅供临床参考，不能替代医师综合判断；纯前端运行，数据不上传: This tool is for clinical reference only and cannot replace comprehensive physician judgment; it runs purely client-side and uploads no data
map.📚 深度解析：GRACE 缺血事件风险评分: In-Depth: GRACE Ischemic Event Risk Score
map.GRACE 缺血事件评分：年龄、心率、收缩压、肌酐、Killip、标志物、ST: GRACE ischemic event score: age, heart rate, SBP, creatinine, Killip, biomarkers, ST deviation and arrest history weighted and summed to predict in-hospital and long-term death / ischemia in ACS.
map.危险分层与侵入时机：高分（多 >140）倾向 24h 内造影 + PCI；极高危: Risk stratification and invasive timing: high score (mostly >140) favors angiography + PCI within 24h; very high risk intervenes immediately.
map.预后与随访：分值联动 6 个月事件风险，指导出院后双抗时长、他汀强度与康复。: Prognosis and follow-up: the score links to 6-month event risk, guiding post-discharge dual antiplatelet duration, statin intensity and rehabilitation.
map.输入：男、61 岁、心率 96、收缩压 118、肌酐 100、Killip I、: Inputs: Male, 61 y, HR 96, SBP 118, creatinine 100, Killip I, troponin +, ST depression, no arrest. Output: GRACE ~109, Stratification Intermediate, Advice Early invasive (angiography within 24h), Follow-up DAPT + high-intensity statin. Note: Value varies with indicators; use the latest.
map.GRACE 与 TIMI 怎么选？: How to choose between GRACE and TIMI?
map.两者均用于 ACS 风险；GRACE 项目更全（含血压/肾/ Killip）、预: Both are used for ACS risk; GRACE has more items (BP / renal / Killip) and more stable mortality prediction, guidelines often use it to set invasive timing; TIMI has fewer items and leans toward ischemic events. They are complementary, not mutually exclusive.
map.侵入策略一定更好吗？: Is an invasive strategy always better?
map.对高危/极高危 NSTE-ACS 早期造影改善预后；低危且出血风险高者可先保守治: Early angiography improves outcomes in high / very-high-risk NSTE-ACS; low-risk with high bleeding risk may start conservative therapy + stress testing. Timing depends on stability, bleeding and team conditions, per chest-pain-center protocol.
map.出院后还要管什么？: What else to manage after discharge?
map.双抗（时长因病种）、高强度他汀、β 阻滞/ACEI 等二级预防，结合心脏康复；按: Dual antiplatelet (duration by disease), high-intensity statin, beta-blocker / ACEI and other secondary prevention, combined with cardiac rehab; tailor follow-up intensity by GRACE risk and control risk factors to reduce recurrence.
map.关于「GRACE 缺血事件风险评分」: About the GRACE Ischemic Event Risk Score
map.GRACE 评分源于全球急性冠脉事件注册研究，综合年龄、心率、血压、肾功能、Ki: The GRACE score originates from the Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events, integrating 8 indicators - age, heart rate, blood pressure, renal function, Killip class, cardiac arrest, ST changes and cardiac enzymes - to assess in-hospital and long-term mortality risk in ACS patients, a key basis for guiding revascularization timing.
map.依据 GRACE 注册研究查表累加: Table lookup summation per the GRACE registry
map.实时输出总分与院内死亡率: Real-time total score and in-hospital mortality rate
map.低/中/高危分层与处置建议: Low / intermediate / high risk stratification and management advice
